summary: XCF Global, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, disclosing a private placement warrant purchase agreement with GL PART SPV II, LLC, an entity controlled by largest beneficial holder Majique Ladnier. The company issued an initial warrant for up to 6,891,798 shares at a $2.50 exercise price for $1,000,000, or $0.1451 per underlying share, closing September 14, 2026, alongside Amendment No. 1 to an April 13, 2026 business combination agreement. Proceeds are nominal; the exemption relied on Section 4(a)(2)/Rule 506(b). Watch dilution, adjustment terms, and BCA closing risk.
